messages.brand.name: Buildy
messages.chat.addAnImageTo: Add an image to the next chat message (UI mock, bug, reference — anything). Not tied to the product brief.
messages.chat.briefCardLead: Load a {spec} SPEC — identity, design, screens, and bricks. The agent rebuilds from {file}.
messages.chat.describeAnEditOr: Describe an edit, or import a product brief SPEC to rebuild another project 1:1 on this template.
messages.chat.describeWhatToDo: Describe what to do with the screenshot…
messages.chat.screenshotReadyEnterSend: Screenshot ready · Enter send · Shift+Enter newline
messages.chat.serverSelectedEvidenceFiles: Server-selected evidence files attached to the last prompt
messages.chat.starter.bugs: Find and fix the most obvious UI bugs
messages.chat.starter.explain: Explain how this project’s main page is structured
messages.chat.starter.layout: Improve the welcome page layout and typography
messages.editor.selectAFileFrom: Select a file from the tree to edit.
messages.editor.zipImportDrop: Drop a Svelte or React ZIP here, or choose a file.
messages.editor.zipImportHint: Import a Svelte or React project ZIP into this empty workspace
messages.editor.zipImportWaitHint: A Go template usually takes about half a minute.
messages.editor.zipHint: The project's files without git, node_modules, build output and .env files
messages.host.agentUnsandboxed: On Windows the agent runs without a sandbox: shell commands have your user's access to files and network. Open only trusted projects. Next versions will run the agent on your own server (Incus, Debian 13).
messages.preview.readyLead: The live preview is ready. Use Refresh to open it. Edits use HMR — the frame is not remounted automatically.
messages.preview.stoppedLead: The preview is stopped. Start the Vite runner to see the app; edits then reload in place.
messages.projects.deleteLead: This permanently deletes {name} and its workspace. Type the app name to confirm.
messages.projects.emptyLead: Create one above — you will land in the agent studio.
messages.projects.lead: Open a project to build with the agent, or start a new one.
messages.projects.title: Your apps
messages.server.debianOnly: The server must run Debian 13 (trixie); Ubuntu and other systems are not supported yet.
messages.server.hostKeyFirst: The first connect pins the server's SSH host key; later connects refuse any other key.
messages.server.keyHint: Once, on the server as root: these lines create the tunnel user, which may only forward the app's two ports (no shell).
messages.server.leadLocal: Connect the app to your own server (Debian 13). The app connects over SSH; the agent, projects and the Cursor key stay on the server.
messages.server.leadRemote: The window shows your server's Studio through an SSH tunnel.
messages.server.outdated: The server is older than this app. It updates itself daily from official releases; to update now, run sudo vibechat-server update on the server.
messages.server.problem.auth: The server refused the app's SSH key or the host token.
messages.server.problem.bad_input: Check the address, the user and the token.
messages.server.problem.host_key_changed: The server's SSH host key has changed. If you reinstalled the server, choose Forget server and connect again; otherwise do not connect.
messages.server.problem.port_busy: A local port the app needs (18121 for previews) is busy on this computer.
messages.server.problem.unreachable: Cannot reach the server over SSH.
messages.server.title: Server
messages.server.tokenHint: Run sudo -u vibechat vibechat-server token new on the server and paste the token. It is kept in this computer's system keychain.
messages.server.tokenSaved: A host token is saved; leave this empty to reuse it.
messages.settings.cursorBlurb: The Studio agent runs on the Cursor SDK. A key saved here is used first, then CURSOR_API_KEY from the environment.
messages.settings.exportLead: An exported transcript can include the thinking and tool rows of the open Studio tab (only while that tab is open). Turn it off for user and assistant messages only.
messages.settings.exportToggle: Include thinking and tool trace in export
messages.settings.lead: Your key stays in the system keychain on this computer and is never shown again after you save it.
messages.settings.leadRemote: Your Cursor key is stored on your server (a file only the server can read) and is never shown again after you save it.
messages.settings.title: API keys
messages.shell.lead: This app is a window to your own server: the agent, projects and previews run there (Debian 13, x86_64). Connect a server you already have, or let the app set up a fresh VPS.
messages.shell.title: BuildY VibeChat
messages.update.appOld: This app speaks protocol {app}, the server needs {min} or newer. Install the latest VibeChat from the releases page.
messages.update.lead: The app and the server cannot talk to each other until one of them is updated.
messages.update.serverOld: The server speaks protocol {server}, this app needs a newer one. The server updates itself daily from official releases; to update now, run sudo vibechat-server update on the server.
messages.update.title: Update needed
